;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[South Sudanese Civil War]]
**[[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition|SPLM-IO]] leader and former [[Vice President of South Sudan|Vice President]] [[Riek Machar]] rejects a peace proposal by President [[Salva Kiir Mayardit]]. While Machar welcomes the provision to reduce the number of [[States of South Sudan|states]] from 32 to 10, he opposes the creation of three administrative areas. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/south-sudan-machar-rejects-president-kiir-peace-offer-200216090638473.html (Al Jazeera)]  
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–present)]]
**Backed by [[Russian Air Force|Russian]] [[airstrike]]s, [[Syrian Army]] troops take control of most of the [[Mount Simeon District|Aleppo countryside]], including the towns of [[Anadan]], [[Haritan]] and [[Kafr Hamrah]] and over 30 villages amid a collapse in rebel defences. Much of the area has been under rebel control since 2012. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-army/russian-backed-syrian-army-seizes-most-of-rebel-held-aleppo-province-state-media-idUSKBN20A0KQ?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/syrian-forces-seize-most-aleppo-province-eve-turkey-russia-talks-n1137631 (NBC News)]
*[[Pansi church shooting]]
**[[Islamist]] gunmen kill at least 24 people, including a [[pastor]], in a [[mass shooting]] on a church during [[mass (liturgy)|mass]] in Pansi, [[Yagha Province]], [[Sahel Region]], [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/burkina-faso-church-attack-kills-dozens/a-52404694 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Business and economy
*The [[United States District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri]] rules that chemical companies [[Bayer]] and [[BASF]] are accountable for the adverse effects of their [[Dicamba]]-based [[herbicide]]s on American farmlands, and awards the plaintiff, a [[peach]] farmer, [[U.S. dollar|US$]]265 million in damages. Bayer announces it will appeal. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bayer-dicamba-lawsuit/u-s-peach-grower-awarded-265-million-from-bayer-basf-in-weedkiller-lawsuit-idUSKBN20A0JJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
*A [[Germany|German]] court orders [[Tesla, Inc.]] to temporarily halt construction of new manufacturing plant [[Giga Berlin]] in [[Grünheide (Mark)|Grünheide]], [[Brandenburg]], due to the threat it poses to the local wildlife and water supplies. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-51525673 (BBC News)]  

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Storm Dennis]]
**The [[Explosive cyclogenesis|bomb cyclone]] claims another victim, bringing the death toll to three.  198 [[flood warning]]s have been placed across [[England]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/02/16/uk/storm-dennis-sunday-intl-gbr/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*[[Azerbaijan]]i [[law enforcement in Azerbaijan|police]] detain three opposition party leaders and more than 100 activists for attempting to protest the results of last week's [[2020 Azerbaijani parliamentary election|parliamentary election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-azerbaijan-election-opposition/azeri-police-detain-opposition-leaders-block-protest-against-election-result-idUSKBN20A0F3?il=0 (Reuters)] 
*Nine [[Homelessness|homeless]] drug users are shot dead while sleeping rough in the [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] capital [[Kabul]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/homeless-drug-users-shot-dead-afghan-capital-police-200217032011711.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Paris municipal election]]
**[[France|French]] Health Minister [[Agnès Buzyn]] announces she will run for the [[List of mayors of Paris|Parisian mayoral]] position on the [[La République En Marche!]] ticket, after the party's original candidate [[Benjamin Griveaux]] withdrew yesterday due to a [[sexting]] scandal. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-politics/french-health-minister-to-run-for-paris-mayor-after-macron-ally-quits-idUSKBN20A0HI?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2020 North Macedonian parliamentary election]]
**The [[Assembly of North Macedonia]] votes 108–12 to dissolve itself after [[North Macedonia|the country]] failed to start [[Accession of North Macedonia to the European Union|accession talks with the European Union]], and sets the parliamentary election date for April 12. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-north-macedonia-election/north-macedonia-parliament-dissolves-sets-poll-date-after-eu-shuns-talks-idUSKBN20A0ON (Reuters)]
